items.reason: Entry requires 'pre-existing documented MTAP homozygous gene deletion in their tumor tissue'; the manual's example 'MTAP deletion + PRMT5/MAT2A inhibitor' covers both S095035 (MAT2A inhibitor) and TNG462 (given in the combination arms).

items.proposed: MTAP homozygous deletion, eligibility, candidate_matched true, matched to s095035 and tng462
items.reason: Both coders agree the MTAP row is an eligibility match; the only difference is whether TNG462 is also named. The primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection true) is the same either way.
The record has nine EXPERIMENTAL arms (e.g. 'Phase 1 Arm 1 - S095035 single-agent dose escalation'), none acting as a control; not_applicable is only for single-arm trials.
PK is planned ('AUC from 0 to infinity', 'Cmax', 'Ctrough') but no sample type is stated; the manual codes this unclear rather than assuming plasma.

note: S095035 role differs by arm (single agent in Arms 1/1a-1d, experimental_combination with TNG462 in Arms 2/2a-2c). IDH-wildtype applies only to define the CNS subgroup ('IDHwt glioblastoma') and is not a selection biomarker; CDKN2A is only a China pre-screening trigger.
